entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: You want a place that really captures[n]the idea of Shinjuku? I wish I had a[n]good answer for you.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: It's just that all the really exciting places[n]aren't really the kinda places I'd want to[n]send high schoolers...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Sorry, kids.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean... this place seems pretty cool.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yes. There's something curiously[n]relaxing about it...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Exotic yet elegant... A truly fascinating[n]place with a fascinating proprietress to[n]match.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So [fName], how do you know[n]this lady?
A friend of a friend.
I work for her.[clr 27]
Can't say.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You got friends everywhere, man...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's an admirable thing to have friends[n]of all kinds. I can only hope to emulate[n]such broad-mindedness.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Me too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, you work here?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Such dedication. It's something to[n]aspire to.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: So you work at a bar! I imagine it's quite[n]a lesson in adult socialization...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What do you mean, you "can't say"!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: [fName]... Is it truly something[n]you cannot share with us?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's quite enough. We needn't pry,[n]and everyone's allowed to have some[n]secrets...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Ah, you kids are a real breath of fresh[n]air around here. All bright-eyed and[n]bushy-tailed...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: I love my regulars, but they're so jaded[n]and worn down. So this is a change of[n]pace.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But if this place attracts such people,[n]then surely that must mean it's a safe[n]haven for them. A place of comfort.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Oh, honey! Aren't you a sweet talker.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Still, that's all I can ask for. I want this[n]to be a place people can relax—[n]especially if they need it that bad.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You are truly a kind soul. Like a great[n]mother watching over Shinjuku...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yes. This store, and Lala-san—it all[n]seems like what Shinjuku should be.

entries.speaker: Drunk Regular
entries.en: Lala-chaaaan! *hic* 'Nother drink!

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Hey, we aren't even open!

entries.speaker: Drunk Regular
entries.en: But... *hic* The lights were on...[n]Can I get a HURK—

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: HEY! If you're gonna vomit, do it in the[n]bathroom! I swear, if you barf on my[n]counter, your ass is banned for LIFE!

entries.speaker: Drunk Regular
entries.en: Y-Yes, ma'am...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Yeesh! Already drunk, and it's not even[n]dark out? What a piece of work...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: The later it gets, the more of these bozos[n]are gonna start showing up. You kids[n]should get home soon.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y-Yes, ma'am...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank you for the juice. Now, let's get[n]going...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I... suppose even the great mother of[n]Shinjuku must discipline her children...
